name: No-Ri-Ko
source:
Game features the japanese singer pop singer Noriko Ogawa, who was just 15 years back in 1988. The games starts with an invitation to one of her live concert. The player, the Lucky Boy as called in the game, will take a day out and probably end up on a date with the young and cute singer. 

[From [url=http://www.videogameden.com/cdrom.htm?nor]videogameden[/url]]
translation:
本作收录日本流行歌手小川范子的形象，她在1988年时年仅15岁。游戏从收到她的现场演唱会邀请开始。玩家，也就是游戏中所谓的幸运男孩，将度过一天，并可能与这位年轻可爱的歌手约会。

[译自[url=http://www.videogameden.com/cdrom.htm?nor]videogameden[/url]]
